Here’s a starter Pkl index Serena can use. Place it at the repo root.

````pkl
// Serena index for free5gc v4.0.1

name        = "free5gc"
version     = "4.0.1"
description = "Index for MCP tool Serena over free5gc v4.0.1"
root        = "."

languages = [
  "go",
  "bash",
  "yaml",
  "json",
  "proto",
  "dockerfile",
  "markdown",
]

include = [
  "NFs/**/*.go",
  "NFs/**/*.proto",
  "NFs/**/*.yaml",
  "NFs/**/*.yml",
  "NFs/**/*.json",
  "NFs/**/*.sh",
  "NFs/**/Dockerfile",
  "internal/**/*.go",
  "pkg/**/*.go",
  "config/**/*.yaml",
  "docs/**/*.md",
  "webconsole/**/*.ts",
  "webconsole/**/*.tsx",
  "webconsole/**/*.js",
  "webconsole/**/*.jsx",
  "webconsole/**/*.json",
  "webconsole/**/Dockerfile",
  "*.md",
]

exclude = [
  "**/.git/**",
  "**/.vscode/**",
  "**/.idea/**",
  "**/.cache/**",
  "**/bin/**",
  "**/build/**",
  "**/dist/**",
  "**/out/**",
  "**/coverage/**",
  "**/vendor/**",
  "webconsole/node_modules/**",
  "node_modules/**",
  "ci-test/artifacts/**",
  "../../go/pkg/mod/**",
  "**/*.log",
  "**/*_test.go",
]

metadata = {
  createdAt = "2025-08-15"
  owner     = "free5gc"
}
````

If Serena expects different keys (e.g., paths.include/paths.exclude or a schema import), share the schema and I’ll adjust.
